name: zeroprep-ai
description: ZeroPrep AI — Stealth Real-Time Interview & DSA Coding Copilot
author: ZeroPrep AI

scripts.electron:compile: tsc electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --outDir electron/dist --target es2020 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck
scripts.dist:mac: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true next build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --mac   --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true next build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win   --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true next build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:all: cross-env ELECTRON_BUILD=true next build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --mac --win --linux --config electron-builder.yml
